# UI telemetry

UI telemetry provides information about how operators interact with the Vault
web interface. Vault emits UI telemetry events only when an operator enables UI
telemetry and a user grants consent. Events carry a generic IBM Tracking Plan
event type and a set of properties for semantic context. Vault never includes
PII, secrets, or request bodies. Users can withdraw consent at any time from
**User preferences -> Data & Privacy -> Share usage metrics**.

To turn on UI telemetry so Vault starts gathering these events, see
[Enable Vault UI telemetry gathering](/vault/docs/internals/telemetry/enable-ui-telemetry).

## Navigation

### Sidebar navigation ((#nav-sidebar))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user clicks a primary or
sub-navigation item in the sidebar.

Property    | Value                                             | Notes
----------- | ------------------------------------------------- | -----
`namespace` | `"nav"`                                           |
`action`    | `"clicked"`                                       |
`elementId` | `"nav-dashboard"`, `"nav-secrets"`, and similar   | One value per sidebar destination: `nav-dashboard`, `nav-secrets`, `nav-access-control`, `nav-acl-policies`, `nav-auth-methods`, `nav-namespaces`, `nav-operational-tools`, `nav-reporting`, `nav-client-count`, `nav-billing-metrics`, `nav-raft-storage`, `nav-resilience-recovery`
`CTA`       | Navigation item label                             | For example, `"Dashboard"`, `"Secrets"`, `"Access control"`
`channel`   | `"webpage"`                                       |

## Dashboard

### Quick actions ((#dashboard-quick-actions))

Emitted as a `CTA Clicked` event when a user clicks a call-to-action in the
quick actions widget or triggers a navigate action.

Property     | Value                                              | Notes
------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | -----
`CTA`        | Button or link label                               |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`                                        |
`location`   | `"dashboard"`                                      |
`objectType` | `"quick-actions-widget"`, `"secrets-engine-widget"`| `quick-actions-widget` for CTA link clicks; `secrets-engine-widget` for navigate actions
`uiElement`  | `"quick-action-cta"`, `"quick-action-navigate"`    |
`type`       | `"Link"`, `"Button"`                               |
`action`     | `"clicked"`, `"navigated"`                         |
`object`     | Secrets engine type, for example `"kv"`, `"pki"`   | Present only on navigate actions

### Secrets engines widget: view all ((#dashboard-secrets-engines-view-all))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user clicks **View all** in the
secrets engines dashboard widget.

Property    | Value                                  | Notes
----------- | -------------------------------------- | -----
`namespace` | `"dashboard"`                          |
`action`    | `"clicked"`                            |
`elementId` | `"dashboard-secrets-engine-view-all"`  |
`channel`   | `"webpage"`                            |

### Secrets engines widget: view engine ((#dashboard-secrets-engines-view-engine))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user clicks a specific engine row in
the secrets engines dashboard widget.

Property     | Value                                            | Notes
------------ | ------------------------------------------------ | -----
`namespace`  | `"dashboard"`                                    |
`action`     | `"clicked"`                                      |
`elementId`  | `"dashboard-secrets-engine-view"`                |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`                                       |
`objectType` | `"secrets-engine"`                               |
`object`     | Backend type of the clicked engine               | For example, `"kv"`, `"pki"`, `"transit"`

## Namespace wizard

### Security policy selection ((#wizard-policy-select))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user selects a security policy in
step 1 of the namespace wizard.

Property     | Value                          | Notes
------------ | ------------------------------ | -----
`namespace`  | `"namespace-wizard"`           |
`action`     | `"selected"`                   |
`elementId`  | `"policy-toggle"`              |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`                    |
`location`   | `"step-1"`                     |
`object`     | `"flexible"`, `"strict"`       | `flexible` for a single namespace; `strict` for multiple namespaces

### Tips section collapse ((#wizard-tips-collapse))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user collapses the tips reveal
section in step 2 of the namespace wizard. Fires only on collapse, not on
re-expand.

Property     | Value                | Notes
------------ | -------------------- | -----
`namespace`  | `"namespace-wizard"` |
`action`     | `"clicked"`          |
`elementId`  | `"tips-reveal"`      |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`          |
`location`   | `"step-2"`           |

### Namespace field input ((#wizard-field-input))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event the first time a user types in the namespace
name field. De-duplicated to fire at most once per wizard session, regardless of
how many keystrokes occur.

Property     | Value                | Notes
------------ | -------------------- | -----
`namespace`  | `"namespace-wizard"` |
`action`     | `"typed"`            |
`elementId`  | `"namespace-field"`  |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`          |
`location`   | `"step-2"`           |

### Creation method selection ((#wizard-method-select))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user selects how to create namespaces
in step 3 of the wizard. The selected method (Terraform, CLI/API, or UI)
determines which event constant Vault uses internally, but the event type is the
same for all three.

Property     | Value                | Notes
------------ | -------------------- | -----
`namespace`  | `"namespace-wizard"` |
`action`     | `"selected"`         |
`elementId`  | `"method-selector"`  |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`          |
`location`   | `"step-3"`           |

## Resource creation

### Secrets engine created ((#create-secrets-engine))

Emitted as a `Created Object` event when a user submits the enable secrets
engine form, on both success and failure.

Property      | Value                                       | Notes
------------- | ------------------------------------------- | -----
`objectType`  | `"secrets-engine"`                          |
`object`      | Engine type, version-suffixed where applicable | For example, `"kv-v2"`, `"pki"`
`process`     | `"UI"`                                      |
`successFlag` | `true`, `false`                             | `true` on success; `false` on failure

### Auth method created ((#create-auth-method))

Emitted as a `Created Object` event when a user submits the enable auth method
form, on both success and failure.

Property      | Value                                      | Notes
------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -----
`objectType`  | `"auth-method"`                            |
`object`      | Auth method type                           | For example, `"oidc"`, `"github"`, `"userpass"`
`process`     | `"UI"`                                     |
`successFlag` | `true`, `false`                            | `true` on success; `false` on failure

### ACL policy created ((#create-acl-policy))

Emitted as a `Created Object` event when a user saves a policy in the policy
editor, on both success and failure.

Property      | Value                          | Notes
------------- | ------------------------------ | -----
`objectType`  | `"policy"`                     |
`object`      | Policy type                    | For example, `"acl"`, `"rgp"`, `"egp"`
`process`     | `"UI"`                         |
`successFlag` | `true`, `false`                | `true` on success; `false` on failure

### Policy creation cancelled ((#create-policy-cancelled))

Emitted as a `UI Interaction` event when a user cancels out of the policy
creation form without saving.

Property     | Value                          | Notes
------------ | ------------------------------ | -----
`namespace`  | `"resource-creation"`          |
`action`     | `"cancelled"`                  |
`elementId`  | `"policy-form"`                |
`channel`    | `"webpage"`                    |
`objectType` | `"policy"`                     |
`object`     | Policy type at cancellation    | For example, `"acl"`, `"rgp"`, `"egp"`

### Namespace created ((#create-namespace))

Emitted as a `Created Object` event when the namespace wizard submits a creation
request, on both success and failure.

Property      | Value                          | Notes
------------- | ------------------------------ | -----
`objectType`  | `"namespace"`                  |
`object`      | Security policy from step 1    | `"flexible"` or `"strict"`; may be undefined if step 1 was not completed
`process`     | `"UI"`                         |
`quantity`    | Number of namespaces submitted | Batch size for the creation request
`successFlag` | `true`, `false`                | `true` on success; `false` on failure
